# ClickUp

> ClickUp is an all-in-one productivity platform that brings together tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single workspace. The platform is highly customizable, supports 15+ view types, and features AI capabilities to streamline workflows and boost team productivity.

ClickUp adapts to any project type, eliminating busywork through automation and keeping everything organized so teams can deliver projects on time. The platform offers a scalable hierarchy structure starting with Workspaces (organization level), Spaces (departments), Folders (projects), Lists (categories), and Tasks (work items).

- [Website Management](https://clickup.com/teams/website-management): Tools for managing web development projects
